steps.en: OCMS gets the company hirer's latest email from the data source
steps.id: OCMS ambil email terbaru hirer perusahaan dari sumber data
steps.why_en: The latest-email lookup is switched off in all environments; the stored email is used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan email terbaru dimatikan di semua environment; email tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Each company hirer's outstanding NOPOs are grouped into one email
steps.id: NOPO outstanding tiap hirer perusahaan digabung dalam satu email
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates produce separate emails for the same company.
steps.why_id: Notice dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda jadi email terpisah untuk perusahaan yang sama.

steps.en: No email goes to companies that opted out or lack an email address
steps.id: Tidak ada email untuk perusahaan yang opt-out atau tanpa alamat email

steps.en: The email lists the outstanding NOPOs and mentions the 2nd letter
steps.id: Email memuat NOPO outstanding dan menyebut 2nd letter
steps.why_en: The message wording is kept in the database, so the reference to the 2nd letter cannot be confirmed here.
steps.why_id: Teks pesan disimpan di database, jadi rujukan ke 2nd letter tidak bisa dipastikan dari sini.

steps.en: The email is sent to the company hirer in the batch run
steps.id: Email dikirim ke hirer perusahaan dalam proses batch
steps.why_en: Email sending and the reminder job are both switched off in production settings, so nothing is sent.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman email dan job reminder sama-sama dimatikan di pengaturan production, jadi tidak ada yang terkirim.
